answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require a refundable work bond tied to a reputation trellis: each new identity locks collateral and must complete verified tasks before it can transact, so spawning a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand bonds. Like a garden, reputation grows slowly through sustained honest work and is pruned when misbehavior is proven; like a mesa, the cost curve is flat and high, so attackers gain nothing from scale while honest agents recover their bond and keep working.
